units.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Python reads Adobe Photoshop .psd files and writes them back, preserving layers, channel information, blend modes, masks, image resources, and image-data structures with RLE and ZIP compression. It inspects document metadata including width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, and image_data_kind. The library supports saving modified documents using the PsdImage.save method and works with Stream objects for stream-based input and output. It depends only on the Python standard library.
It inspects document metadata by exposing width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, and image_data_kind on the PsdImage class.
It provides access to the layer model through the layer class, which exposes name, bounds, opacity, visibility, and channelinformation per layer.
It handles blend modes using the blendmode enum and layerblendmodemapper to map between 4-character PSD keys and enum values.
It parses channel information using channelinformation to represent per-channel compression, length, and identifier, raising notsupportedexception on write attempts.
It exposes raw length and basic properties of layer mask and blending range data without supporting mutations.
It parses image resources using imageresourcessection, unknownresource, and psdresourceinfo to expose raw payloads and metadata such as resource_id and name.

It parses image data structure using imagedata and imagedatastructure to expose compression kind, row_length_field_size, row_byte_counts, compressed_payload_length, and uses_prediction without pixel decoding.
It performs byte-exact round-trip saving using PsdImage.save, preserving all unmodified sections to enable lossless save-load cycles.
This example loads a PSD file and prints each layer's index, name, and bounds to inspect the image structure.

The public entry point is the aspose_psd_foss package. It provides the PsdImage class to load, inspect, and save Adobe Photoshop files, and exposes layer, resource, and section types for detailed manipulation.

The PsdImage class represents a Photoshop document and exposes properties such as width, height, color_mode, compression, layer_count, is_psb, resource_count, and methods like load and save to read and write files, as well as access to layers and resources.
The header property of PsdImage returns a psdheader object that contains the file's structural metadata.

BigEndianWriter class provides methods for writing binary data in big-endian order, including write_byte, write_bytes, write_all_bytes, write_int16, write_int32, write_uint16, and write_pascal_string_aligned_to_2.
LayerAndMaskSectionReader class provides a load method to read layer and mask section data, which raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
Point class represents a point in two-dimensional space with members empty, equals, and is_empty.
PsdVersion enum lists the Psb and Psd version values.
Size class represents a size in two-dimensional space with members IsEmpty, empty, equals, and is_empty.
GlobalLayerMaskInfo class provides an empty method for creating an empty instance.

Layer class provides properties such as IsVisible, additional_layer_data, blend_mode_key, blending_ranges_info, bottom, bounds, channel_info, and channel_information, where channel_information, layer_blending_ranges_data, and layer_mask_data setters raise NotSupportedException.
LayerBlendingRangesInfo class provides read-only properties is_present and raw_data_length.
LayerBlendModeMapper class provides methods get_blend_mode_key and parse_blend_mode_key.
LayerMaskInfo class provides read-only properties is_present and raw_data_length.
LayerRawData class provides methods WithBlendModeKey, empty, and with_blend_mode_key.
LayerRecordReader class provides a load method and constants ADOBE_LAYER_SIGNATURE, ADOBE_LAYER_SIGNATURE_TEXT, and LAYER_INVISIBLE_FLAG, where load raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
LayerResource class provides read-only properties key, length, psd_version, and signature, and a save method, where psd_version getter always returns 0.
RawLayerBlendingRangesSection class provides methods empty and load, and a read-only property raw_data, where load raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
RawLayerMaskSection class provides methods empty and load, and a read-only property raw_data, where load raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
PsdImageLoader class provides a load method that raises PsdLoadException under certain conditions.
IndexedColorPalette class provides read-only property entries and methods parse and to_public_info.
PsdResourceKind enum lists the GLOBAL_ANGLE, ICC_PROFILE, ICC_UNTAGGED_PROFILE, and UNKNOWN resource kind values.
PsdImageDataInfo class provides read-only properties compressed_payload_length, kind, row_byte_counts, row_length_field_size, and uses_prediction.

TestAsposeCompatibility class provides test methods test_channels_officialshape_readsonly, test_image_load_official_returns_psd, test_image_setters_updatemetadata, test_layermask_officialshape_reads, test_metadata_officialtypes_reads, test_rectangle_mutableshape_updates, test_resources_officialshape_reads, and test_save_officialmutation_persists.

TestColorData class provides test methods test_load_cmykpayload_classifies, test_load_indexeddata_parsespalette, test_load_indexedfixture_readsdata, test_load_rgbpayload_classifies, test_load_toolongcolormode_throws, and test_save_indexedfixture_isbyteexact.

TestFixtureDocument class provides test methods test_load_basiccmyk_readsmetadata, test_load_basicpsb_readsmetadata, test_load_basicrgb_readsmetadata, test_load_layeredpsb_readslayers, test_load_layervariants_readsflags, test_save_basiccmyk_isbyteexact, test_save_basicpsb_isbyteexact, and test_save_basicrgb_isbyteexact.

TestImageData class provides test methods test_load_psbrle_readsstructure, test_load_psdrle_readsstructure, test_load_psdzip_readsstructure, test_load_rlefixture_readsimagedata, test_load_truncatedrlerows_throws, test_load_zipfixture_readsimagedata, test_save_rlefixture_isbyteexact, and test_save_zipfixture_isbyteexact.
TestImageResourcesSection class provides test methods test_load_resources_reads_blocks, test_load_resourcesfixture_reads, test_save_resources_preserves_raw, and test_save_resourcesfixture_raw.
InspectionDtoTests class provides test methods test_load_document_dtos_read_values and test_load_layer_dtos_read_values.

TestLayerSection class provides test methods test_load_layerinspection_readsvalues, test_load_negativelayerextra_throws, test_load_psblayerrecord_reads, test_load_toolonglayerextra_throws, test_load_toolonglayermask_throws, test_save_changesblendmode, test_save_changesbounds, and test_save_changesclipping.
TestPascalString class provides test methods test_read_aligned2_consumes_padding and test_read_aligned4_consumes_padding.
TestPsdHeaderTests class provides test methods test_load_invalid_header_field_throws, test_load_nonzero_reserved_throws, test_load_psbheader_reads_metadata, and test_load_psdheader_reads_metadata.

TestPsdImageLoad class provides test methods test_load_docinspection_reads, test_load_document_readsproperties, test_load_invalidsignature_throws, test_load_layer_readsproperties, test_load_layers_indexable, test_load_missingfile_throws, test_load_nonseekablestream_succeeds, and test_load_nullstream_throws.

TestPsdImagesaveTests class provides test methods test_save_changes_layer_name, test_save_changes_layer_opacity, test_save_changes_layer_visibility, test_save_mutation_preserves_flags, test_save_roundtrip_is_byte_exact, and test_save_roundtrip_loads_again.
